name: Lead Intake
summary: Every inbound inquiry becomes a Twenty record within 1 business hour, and the prospect gets a real reply within 24 hours.

name: Pre-Shoot Gear Pull
summary: Every shoot leaves the studio with the right kit, packed, charged, and labeled. Triggered when a Job enters In Prep.

name: Day-of-Shoot Brief
summary: Crew arrives knowing the schedule, their role, the client expectation, and the wrap target.

name: Post-Shoot Data Wrangling
summary: Every card lands in two destinations with verified checksums before any card is wiped. No footage loss.

name: First-Cut Review
summary: Get the first watchable cut in front of internal eyes (then client) with structured feedback.

name: Final Delivery + Invoice
summary: Final files reach the client, the final invoice goes out, and the Job moves to Delivered.

name: Crew Onboarding
summary: New freelance crew end up in the right systems on day one: Twenty, contracted, paid setup, gear-access permission.

name: Vendor Onboarding
summary: Bringing on a new vendor is fast and consistent so future Quotes and Jobs reference them cleanly.
